card.name: Linking words before enzyme-strength terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as and, or, to, or major right after strong or moderate, just before CYP enzyme or inhibitor/inducer terms. It also fires partway through the name Remifentanil.

modes.label: Strong/moderate CYP links
modes.description: A joining word between strength terms, before CYP3A inhibitors or inducers.

modes.label: Modifier before enzymes
modes.description: A word like major leading into cytochrome P450 enzymes in interaction studies.
modes.example: potential of gabapentin to inhibit the<< major>> cytochrome P450 enzymes

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through the drug name remifentanil in a dilution heading.
modes.example: Reconstitution and Dilution of Rem<<if>>entanil Hydrochloride for injection
